best_parts: node lvl_pair_t1: names the tempting high-small-bowel set, the wrong model (one timeline at every level), and the right set, plus a sure_note for confident errors
nodes str_case and sign_case: the strangulation trap (TR22) is re-tested in a second form (single-reading probe, then a which-finding probe), which meets the different-form re-test rule
node bs_pair with bs_t1: 'blocked means silent' is named as the wrong model and reversed in one line
flaws: lvl_pair, lvl_mech, bs_pair, ileus_case, str_case, sign_case: the correct option is always listed first across all six probes, so position telegraphs the key (DP1)
lvl_pair_t1, lvl_mech_t1, bs_t1, ileus_t1, str_t1: a first miss gets the full 'What is right' answer with no hint first; the hint ladder (DP9) is absent from every probe
str_case: 'Obstruction resolving, so the pain is settling' is dominated, since the stem already says the pain is constant; a tired student drops it at once
lvl_pair / lvl_mech: O3 is taught for the colon block only; low small bowel appears just in the recap device line, so high, low and large bowel are not all probed (partial O3 coverage)
whole segment: no fast lane and one linear path, so a confident expert and a novice get identical nodes (R5)

best_parts: nodes start / a_h1 / a_h2 / a_hg: first miss on the high-block probe gets a hint that names the tempting model and points to the level, with a retry (correct hint ladder, no answer given)
nodes snd / snd_h1 / snd_h2 / snd_hg: sound probe where the hint asks what the gut is doing at the block, then a fresh probe on the same block; the second-miss feedback names the belief
node pain / pain_h1 / pain_b: strangulation probe with a hint on what has changed (colic to constant), then a re-ask; trap TR22 is given a qualifier-based hint rather than the answer
node why: asks the learner to explain why constipation is late high and early low before the explanation (ask before tell)
flaws: why_x1, why_x2, ile_x1, cnot_x1, cnot_x2: a first miss goes straight to 'Right: ...' feedback with the answer, with no hint and retry first (DP9)
pain: 'Paralytic ileus supervening after the colic' is dominated, since a fast pulse and a tender loop do not fit a quiet gut and a tired student drops it at once

cnot: the two traps (fever with tachycardia, localised guarding) are themselves strangulation signs, so anyone who knows the signs rejects them; they test 'fever is non-specific', which is only loosely TR22 (mapping stretched)
start_b and snd_b: the re-test is the same question in the same form ('same block, asked again'), so the delayed re-test is not in a different form (rule: re-test in another form)
start / why / snd / ile / pain / cnot: no 'Give me a clue' option on ile and cnot, and no fast lane for an expert who answers start correctly and confidently

best_parts: node belief: the classmate's claim 'the level changes nothing' is a clean belief probe, so the path reveals the learner's model at the first choice
node pain_probe / pain_hint: the classmate's 'colic always means a simple block' frames the key probe, and the hint asks what changed in the pain and pulse
node sound_contrast / contrast_t18b: the silent post-laparotomy belly is set against a twisted loop, so the mechanical-versus-adynamic trap is probed in a case, not a definition
node level_probe / level_h1: first miss on the large-bowel probe gets a hint naming the learned high-block set and a fresh question, with no answer given
flaws: level_mech: the three feature sets (high small bowel, low small bowel, large bowel) are told in full before the learner is asked, which breaks ask-before-tell (R1)
the correct option sits in position 2 on seven of the eight probes (belief, level_probe, sound, sound_contrast, pain_probe, pain_probe2, which; level_probe2 has it in 3), a visible pattern (DP1)
pain_probe / pain_probe2: 'Resolving obstruction, the colic is settling' is dominated, since the stem says the pain is constant and severe
sound, sound_contrast, which: a first miss goes to 'Right: ...' feedback with the answer and no hint first (DP9)
level_h1 / level_h2 / pain_h1: hints on a confident error carry no sure_note, so the hypercorrection cue is missing on the first miss (inconsistent with sure_note on the matching feedback)

merge_ideas: b's start/snd/pain hint ladder (first miss = hint, retry on a fresh probe) plus a's lvl_pair_t1 refutation style, applied to every probe including why, ile and cnot
c's belief probe as the opener of b's segment, so the learner commits to a model before the level probes
a's str_case then sign_case pairing (same trap, different form) added to b's pain and cnot nodes, to give a true different-form re-test
key position randomised across the segment (no key-first or key-second pattern), with the dominated 'resolving' and 'settling' options replaced by traps that still fit the stem's constant pain
a fast lane: a belief or start probe answered correctly and confidently skips the explanation nodes into the recap (expertise reversal), which none of the three offers
